title: Ready for the fall
style: male vocalist, breathy verses, powerful chorus, sparse acoustic guitar, stomping beat, americana, slow build, raw intimate production, gritty emotion, space between phrases, dynamic swells, 85 bpm
lyrics:
[verse]
Take me apart
Hold my hand
I'll build you castles not made of sand
Your eyes they burn
They pull me in
You're at that table
I'm caving in

[pre-chorus]
'Cause I'm thinking you might just be the one
That I ravage in the moonlight all night long

[chorus]
You and me got something right
Something true, something with bite
You got all that attitude
Dark bedroom eyes
That see right through my walls
Now I'm standing on this edge
And I'm ready for the fall

[verse]
I've played it safe
I've kept it tight
But you walked in
And wrecked my life
You don't ask
You just stare
Like you know what's there
Before I get there

[pre-chorus]
'Cause I'm thinking you might just be the one
That I chase into the darkness just for fun

[chorus]
You and me got something right
Something true, something with bite
You got all that attitude
Dark bedroom eyes
That see right through my walls
Now I'm standing on this edge
And I'm ready for the fall

[bridge]
I don't need safe
Don't need soft
I just want you
To burn it off
Everything

[chorus]
You and me got something right
Something true, something with bite
You got all that attitude
Dark bedroom eyes
That see right through my walls
Now I'm falling off this edge
And I don't mind at all

[outro]
Take me apart
Hold my hand
Tell you something true
